title: Messages opens on the shared header with a start state and an Unread filter
detail: The Frequency Messages inbox opens on the shared PageHeading (kicker, title, one warm line that counts what is waiting, actions: New message, Start a room, Ask Vera) instead of a bare list title. An open conversation keeps its height back and the old list title. The empty pane offers Message someone, Find a room and Ask Vera. The inbox gains an Unread filter with a count. The loading frame draws the same header so nothing jumps.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const bad=[];const b=fs.readFileSync('components/frequency/members/messages/messages-body.tsx','utf8');if(!b.includes('<PageHeading'))bad.push('inbox lost the shared header');if(!b.includes('fa-start'))bad.push('start state gone');if(!fs.readFileSync('components/frequency/members/messages/inbox-list.tsx','utf8').includes(\"['unread', 'Unread']\"))bad.push('Unread filter gone');if(!fs.readFileSync('components/frequency/members/messages/messages-states.tsx','utf8').includes('className=\"head\"'))bad.push('loading frame lost the header');if(bad.length){console.error('LIVE-1024: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails when the inbox drops the shared header, the start state, the Unread filter, or the loading frame's matching header.
